question: Which of the five warmups accounts for X-minus-U wall cost in each sealed block?
method: Use sealed analysis.json by_phase accounting; read only warmup raw observation_end_s and actual call execution tags. Pair same block, ordinal and phase, retaining all eight ordinals. Do not regenerate routes or rerun GPU.

metric_semantics.wall_s: Complete raw capture observation_end_s, seconds. Five separate captures are sequential and can be summed.
metric_semantics.payload_bytes: Recorded actual H2D submitted expert-weight payload; not measured PCIe wire bytes.
metric_semantics.d2d_bytes: Recorded D2D expert payload, separate from H2D.
metric_semantics.groups: Actual executed expert groups, not canonical hypothetical groups.
metric_semantics.host_plan_ms: Shared planner field, summed within phase. Ordinary expert path has no separate host_plan_ms field; analyzer represents absence as 0, not zero total planning cost.
metric_semantics.host_apply_ms: Sum of nested per-call host apply spans; do not add to wall or CUDA spans.
metric_semantics.load_section_ms: Sum of per-call recorded CUDA load-section spans; overlaps host apply and wall. Never add these categories into another total.

execution_sources: shared_pool_performance/source/run_shared_pool_pager.py:181-185 routes protected warmups to ordinary private21 expert groups; unprotected oneshot uses shared planner
shared_pool_performance/protocol.json: uniform private24; oneshot private21+48; protected common warmups ordinary execution
observed: All positive mean warmup wall increments are in the three protected ordinary-group warmups. X uses private21 while U uses private24. Unprotected X oneshot warmup and none-injection warmup have lower mean walls in both blocks. Protected phases have no shared_plan time field or recorded expert D2D, while actual H2D/groups are larger.
causal_boundary: Localization is observational: independent X/U route, output and inherited cache trajectories differ; private cap, previous phases, shared dispatch wrapper and engine/order/environment can contribute. No same-prestate cap-only ablation, no exclusive timing-bucket attribution, and no claim that shared dispatch overhead is zero. Correlated repeats are not eight independent samples; no significance claim.
experiment_boundary: No new GPU run, continuous-service gain, steady-state denominator or change to the frozen X/F next step.
